villa_snapshot: Villa snapshot

Set along the gentle curve of a slow-moving Goan river & just a short 3-4 km drive from Candolim Beach, this six-bedroom private villa unfolds like a quiet revelation. From the moment you step inside, a deep sense of calm takes over as if the noise of the world has been softened to a whisper. Every detail feels deliberate, curated, & quietly confident.

The infinity pool is the first to draw you in - sleek, elongated, & perfectly aligned with the river’s edge. It mirrors the shifting sky above & blurs the boundary between land & water. Be it swimming at sunrise or reclining with a drink at dusk, the experience is elemental yet indulgent, as though nature itself were crafted for your utmost comfort.

At the heart of the home lies an expansive living room, where texture, light, & proportion come together in thoughtful harmony. Earthy tones, handcrafted details, & sculptural accents flow seamlessly into a refined dining space & a streamlined, fully equipped kitchen built for slow mornings, long conversations, & everything in between.

Each of the six bedrooms is a private haven, layered with natural materials, handcrafted furnishings, & floor-to-ceiling glass that draws in the surrounding green. Bathtubs in select rooms offer an added layer of calm, while river-facing balconies in every room bring the gift of pure, complete stillness. From soft linens to ambient lighting, every touchpoint is designed to soothe, not overwhelm.
For added ease & comfort, a private lift connects all levels of the villa, ensuring effortless access throughout the home without ever breaking the flow of its relaxed rhythm.

With uninterrupted vistas, the villa offers multiple spaces to retreat t,o including a quiet indoor lounge and an upper-level area that feels almost cinematic. The first intimate space completes the experience, air-conditioned yet intimately connected to the outdoors through expansive windows, layered foliage, and a thoughtfully designed bar nook. From bespoke light fixtures to finely crafted joinery, every detail reflects a quiet dedication to refined taste.

With a picturesque balcony overlooking the river and skies that shift from gold to indigo, the elevated terrace lounge becomes a place where time stretches, ideal for leisurely breakfasts, quiet reading, or evenings that linger well past sunset.

To enhance your stay, an exceptional 5-star hospitality team is at your service, offering seamless attention with warmth and grace. From a dedicated butler and chef-on-call to an expertly curated welcome basket and fully stocked fridge, every detail has been carefully designed to ensure comfort and indulgence. With a commitment to excellence, the essence of "Atithi Devo Bhava" is embodied in every moment, ensuring you feel truly cherished throughout your stay.
Discreet, graceful, & deeply restorative, this villa is not just a place to stay it’s a place to relive.
Note:
Curbside parking is available for your convenience.
Please refrain from swimming in the river for safety purposes.
Outdoor Pool: The Infinity Cascade

A tranquil outdoor pool that flows into the river’s edge, framed by lush greenery, elegant loungers, and direct access from the living room, offering uninterrupted views and quiet immersion in nature.
Living Area: Azure Reverie
An exquisite ground-floor lounge with vibrant seating, 75” TV, premium sound system, ACs, chandelier, and antique touches—opening to serene river and pool views, with a staircase leading upstairs.
Dining Space: River's Edge Bistro
Elegant dining featuring a refined table with plush blue chairs, statement chandelier, and designer sideboard, opening to stunning river and pool views.
Living Room 2: Riverfront Retreat
A cosy first-floor retreat featuring beige sofas, wooden details, a chic bar nook, and a compact kitchenette. French windows offer seamless river views, all set within a calm, natural palette.
Lounge Area: Regalia Lounge
Bright & inviting, this second-floor lounge features bold accents & sweeping river views through floor-to-ceiling windows. TV 55". Balcony access & an ensuite bathroom complete this refined retreat.
Bedrooms
Bedroom 1: The Lush Retreat

Discover refined comfort in this serene first-floor suite, featuring a king bed, ensuite bath, and direct pool access. Soft green accents, ambient lighting, and expansive windows frame picturesque river vistas, offering a perfect blend of calm and understated luxury.
Bathroom 1
Refined bathroom with a sizzling bathtub, glass-enclosed shower with hand jet spray, ceramic basin, bespoke vanity, organic toiletries, plush towels, hairdryer, Western commode, and elegant mirror.
Bedroom 2: Rosewood Cove

Step into refined comfort in this ground-floor suite, featuring a king bed, ensuite bath, and direct pool access. Calming green tones, ambient lighting, and expansive windows with river views create an atmosphere of quiet elegance.
Bathroom 2

Elegant bathroom featuring a bathtub, glass-enclosed shower with geyser and hand jet spray, ceramic sink, vanity storage, organic toiletries, plush towels, hairdryer, Western commode, and a stylish mirror.
Bedroom 3: Riverine Suite

A tranquil ground-floor haven featuring a king bed, an ensuite bath, and seamless pool access. With calming green accents & large windows framing stunning river views, it’s a serene retreat designed for total relaxation.
Bathroom 3
Luxurious bathroom with shower, geyser, hand jet spray, ceramic basin, bespoke vanity, organic toiletries, plush towels, Western commode, hairdryer, and elegant mirror.
Bedroom 4: Skyward Gaze

This airy first-floor suite offers a king-sized bed, an ensuite bath, & a private balcony framing stunning river views. Soft blue tones, curated artwork, and a refined workstation blend comfort and calm, creating a space ideal for both rest & focused work.
Bathroom 4
Well-appointed bathroom featuring a shower with geyser and hand jet spray, hairdryer, ceramic sink, vanity storage, organic toiletries and towels, Western commode, and mirror.
Bedroom 5: Rhapsody in Blue

Beautifully designed, this first-floor suite features a king bed, ensuite bath, and a balcony with scenic river views. Soft lighting, curated art, and warm wooden accents create a tranquil space for rest and reflection.
Bathroom 5
Modern bathroom with a glass shower cubicle, geyser, hand jet spray, hairdryer, ceramic basin, vanity storage, organic toiletries, towels, mirror, and Western commode.
Bedroom 6: Emerald Eden

Thoughtfully appointed, this first-floor suite features a king bed, ensuite bath, 55” TV, and a refined seating area with a dedicated workstation. Sliding glass doors open to a private balcony, where uninterrupted river views and soft natural light complete the sense of calm and comfort.
Bathroom 6
Luxuriously equipped bathroom with a bathtub, glass shower cubicle, geyser, hand jet spray, ceramic basin, vanity storage, organic toiletries, hairdryer, mirror, and Western commode.
Kitchen: The Gourmet Studio

A thoughtfully designed ground-floor kitchen featuring generous storage, ambient ceiling lighting, and a full suite of modern appliances—ranging from oven and dishwasher to RO system, cookware, and curated essentials—offering both function and finesse for seamless culinary experiences.
